text:
Alex: Quick sync — Beacon needs a demo next week. Proposal: shrink MVP surface so we can guarantee 5/15 ship and a stable canary. Cut candidates: org analytics UI, tenant onboarding flow, and role-scoped RBAC. Keep SSO + baseline telemetry + usage quotas.

Priya: Agree on cuts. Beacon cares most about SSO + predictable demos. We can offer a CSV export as a temporary "usage report" instead of UI.

Jonah: Multi-tenant and onboarding both touch auth and DB migrations. Est. effort: 10 dev-days + migration window. Not safe for this sprint.

Mei: Design note — hiding the Usage tab will confuse trial users. Suggest we show a disabled tile with "Request usage report" CTA and tooltip explaining v1 features.

Raj: Beacon will push back on exports vs UI. If we promise analytics in v1, need a clear timeline. Can we commit to v1 by end of Q3?

Nora: If we commit to Q3, add it to public roadmap with a guarded date and "subject to capacity" note. Also track customer impact in CS.

Alex: Decision lean: ship MVP without analytics UI and without multi-tenant onboarding. Ship instrumentation + CSV export + simple per-org hard limits. v1 scope: analytics UI, multi-tenant onboarding, granular RBAC.

Priya: Action list:
- Priya -> update roadmap & customer comms (send Beacon note)
- Jonah -> migration plan + DB risk doc (EOD Thu)
- Mei -> mock disabled Usage tile + CSV export flow (tomorrow)
- Nora -> CS playbook for Beacon demo (include export)
- Raj -> negotiate Beacon expectations, ask for patience on UI
- Alex -> signoff on canary settings

DeployBot: TASK-4910 created: "MVP: telemetry + CSV usage export".

Jonah: Canary plan suggestion: 5% traffic 24h, validate latency + cost, then 25% for 48h. Rollback if 95th p90 latency > SLO or token cost spike > 2x baseline.

Alex: Good. Also include automatic model fallback in rollout: if token cost spike, shift to smaller model pair for 1h and notify oncall.

Priya: One more: billing/quotas — Ben suggested soft limits that pause new seat creation and surface an alert. We should implement as feature-flagged behavior for MVP.

Mei: UX for pause: modal explaining "quota reached" + contact sales link. I'll add to mocks.

Raj: I'll take point with Beacon and schedule a dry-run demo for Tuesday. Need the CSV path and demo script.

Alex: Thanks team. If no objections, I'll post a short exec note and update the public roadmap after Raj confirms Beacon cadence. Ping here for any blockers before EOD. :thumbsup:
